title: Ideas get stronger when people come together
excerpt: From founder workshops to conversations about AI and society, Jen’s work has often involved bringing the right people into a room. Her experience spans teaching, conference development, startup mentoring, and policy dialogue, connecting practical business questions with the communities that can help move them forward.

title: A sounding board for the people building next
excerpt: Founders need room to think alongside the pressure to act. Jen’s mentoring work spans accelerator communities, startup programs, and individual founder relationships. It draws on experience in growth, brand, partnerships, and leadership, with support that can extend from an early coaching conversation into a longer relationship.

title: What should AI mean for human connection?
excerpt: HumanConnections.AI brings a human question into the development of technology: how can AI support social connection and flourishing? Jen helped create the initiative and contributed as an advisor, connecting researchers, technologists, investors, and policymakers through gatherings, collaborations, and a broader conversation about the choices ahead.

title: Recognized for showing up for founders
excerpt: Techstars named Jennifer Tacheff among its 2023 All-Star Mentors for the Techstars Anywhere Remote Accelerator. Announced in February 2024, the recognition celebrates mentors who went beyond expectations in supporting founders and building meaningful relationships within the accelerator community.

title: Stories that travel beyond the boardroom
excerpt: A clear story can help a founder, an author, or a creative team find its audience. Jen’s work extends into books, independent film, and creative businesses, combining marketing and positioning with encouragement, fundraising support, and the relationships that help a project become real.

title: Five starting points for your next move
excerpt: Launching a fund, scaling a company, and entering a new market ask different questions. Manifest’s work brings growth, capital, brand, leadership, and innovation into the same conversation. A useful starting point is the decision in front of you and what needs to change for that decision to succeed.
